journey_definitions.AUT-J15: Author word timing: open → select two neighbors → draft ranges → save/cancel → direct shift/endpoint variant

source_lines: private func withFixture(_ check: (WorkspaceStore, URL, URL, Data, Data, Data) async throws -> Void) async throws {
throw XCTSkip("Requires isolated verification storage; never construct a live user workspace.")
for _ in 0..<500 where store.isBootstrapping { try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(10)) }
var mainBytes = png(.blue), portraitBytes = png(.green), wrongBytes = png(.red)
for bytes in [mainBytes, portraitBytes, wrongBytes] { XCTAssertNotNil(UIImage(data: bytes)) }
try mainBytes.write(to: mainURL); try portraitBytes.write(to: portraitURL)
let main = ImageAsset(id: "main", fileName: "main.png", sha256: ScrivDigest.sha256(mainBytes), byteCount: mainBytes.count, characterIds: ["mara"])
let portrait = ImageAsset(id: "portrait", fileName: "portrait.png", sha256: ScrivDigest.sha256(portraitBytes), byteCount: portraitBytes.count)
entries: [ScriptEntry(id: "line", sceneId: "scene", order: 0, text: "Synthetic scene", ownedDurationMs: 1000)],
images: [main, portrait], cues: [ImageCue(id: "cue", sceneId: "scene", imageId: main.id, label: "01A", startMs: 0, endMs: 1000)])
try await check(store, mainURL, portraitURL, mainBytes, portraitBytes, wrongBytes)

oracle_category_definitions.public-state-or-persistence: Exact labels, field values, enabled states, saved records, metadata or bytes.
oracle_category_definitions.route-specific: Specific control/menu/key/gesture activation; programmatic handler invocation is not physical route proof.
oracle_category_definitions.layout-geometry: Native frames, fitting sizes, wrapping, reachability and hierarchy; no pixel parity inferred.
oracle_category_definitions.pixel-artifact-without-baseline-comparis: Baseline captured a screenshot artifact but did not assert pixel comparison. Preserve artifacts without claiming visual parity.
oracle_category_definitions.lifecycle-or-fault: Cancellation, stale ownership, async races, storage/network failures or reopening; controlled boundary setup required.
oracle_category_definitions.implementation-only-needs-witness: Object identity, selector registration, constraint structure or callback count requires direct read-only instrumentation or explicit unresolved observable-contract disposition.
